Successful creations are written to the dedicated {@code AUDIT} logger so the 28 * side-effect can be routed and asserted independently of application logging. 29 */ 30 @Component 31 public class OwnerAuditLogger { 32 33 private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT"); 34 35 /** 36 * Record that an owner was successfully created. 37 * 38 * @param owner the persisted owner, with its generated id, customer code and registration date 39 */ 40 public void logCreated(Owner owner) { 41 AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}", 42 owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate()); 43 } 44 } 45
